name: full-audit
description: 🔍 Complete codebase audit: security + performance + test coverage

steps.name: Security Scan
steps.task: Perform a comprehensive security audit of the entire codebase. Find vulnerabilities, hardcoded secrets, and security issues.

steps.name: Performance Analysis
steps.task: Analyze the codebase for performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, and inefficient algorithms.

steps.name: Test Coverage Check
steps.task: Analyze test coverage and identify critical functions without tests. Generate missing tests for high-priority code.

steps.name: Database Optimization
steps.task: Analyze database queries for N+1 problems, missing indexes, and slow queries.
